name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)

eligibility.land_holding: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land
eligibility.notes: Farmer must own agricultural land. Institutional landholders, government employees, income taxpayers excluded.

benefits: Rs. 6000 per year in 3 equal installments of Rs. 2000 directly into bank account
how_to_apply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Fill in land and bank details
Local Patwari/Revenue Officer will verify land records
tags: farmer income support cash transfer agriculture kisan

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

eligibility.notes: Any Indian citizen without a bank account. Minors above 10 years can open account.

benefits: Zero balance bank account, RuPay debit card, Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance, Rs. 30,000 life insurance, overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000
documents_needed: Aadhaar card or any KYC document
how_to_apply: Visit any nationalized bank branch or Post Office
Ask for PMJDY account opening form
Account opens immediately with zero balance
tags: bank account zero balance financial inclusion insurance overdraft rupay

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)

eligibility.notes: Rural households listed in SECC 2011 data without pucca house. Priority to SC/ST, minorities, disabled.

benefits: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plains) or Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for construction of pucca house. 90-95 days MGNREGS wage support.
how_to_apply: Check if your name is in SECC 2011 beneficiary list at pmayg.nic.in
Visit Gram Panchayat office if eligible
Gram Sabha selects and verifies beneficiaries
Funds transferred in installments linked to construction progress
Upload geo-tagged photos at each stage via AwaasSoft app
tags: housing rural pucca house BPL construction subsidy gramin awas

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

eligibility.income: EWS up to Rs.3L, LIG Rs.3-6L, MIG-I Rs.6-12L, MIG-II Rs.12-18L annual income
eligibility.notes: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Female co-ownership required for EWS/LIG.

benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh on home loan. Interest subsidy 3-6.5% depending on income slab.
how_to_apply: Apply through bank/housing finance company taking home loan
Submit application with income and property documents
Bank verifies and submits to National Housing Bank/HUDCO
Subsidy credited directly to loan account
tags: housing urban subsidy home loan interest credit linked EWS LIG MIG first home

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)

eligibility.notes: Non-farm income generating activities. No collateral required. For micro and small businesses.

benefits: Shishu: loan up to Rs. 50,000 | Kishor: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakh | Tarun: Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh. No collateral. Low interest rates.
how_to_apply: Visit any bank, MFI, or NBFC offering MUDRA loans
tags: business loan entrepreneur startup small business self employed no collateral mudra shishu kishor tarun

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility.income: Family income below Rs. 2.5 lakh per year
eligibility.notes: SC students studying in Class 11 and above. Day scholars and hostellers both eligible.

benefits: Maintenance allowance Rs. 380-1200/month (depending on course level), course fees reimbursement, study tour charges, thesis printing charges
how_to_apply: Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
Select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC' scheme
Fill application with academic and income details
Institution verifies and forwards to district officer
tags: SC scholarship education post matric class 11 12 college university maintenance allowance

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students

eligibility.income: Family income below Rs. 2.5 lakh per year
eligibility.notes: ST students studying in Class 11 and above including professional courses.

benefits: Maintenance allowance, tuition fees, other academic charges covered. Higher rates for professional courses like MBBS, engineering.
how_to_apply: Register and select ST Post-Matric Scholarship
Fill form and upload tribe and income certificate
tags: ST tribal scholarship education post matric professional courses maintenance

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)

eligibility.notes: 8th pass for projects above Rs. 10 lakh in manufacturing. Preference to SC/ST/women/minorities/ex-servicemen/differently abled. Existing units not eligible.

benefits: Subsidy 15-35% of project cost (up to Rs. 25 lakh manufacturing, Rs. 10 lakh service). Bank loan for remainder. SC/ST/women get 35% subsidy in rural areas.
how_to_apply: Select KVIC, KVIB, or DIC as implementing agency
Appear for interview at KVIC/KVIB/DIC office
Loan sanctioned; subsidy released after 3 years lock-in
tags: self employment business startup loan subsidy MSME manufacturing service KVIC

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility.income: Family income below Rs. 1.5 lakh per year
eligibility.notes: OBC students in Class 11 and above. Studying in recognized institutions.

benefits: Maintenance allowance Rs. 256-1000/month, reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
how_to_apply: Fill and submit with supporting documents
tags: OBC scholarship education post matric maintenance allowance fees

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)

eligibility.notes: Must have a savings bank account. Auto-debits Rs. 20/year premium.

benefits: Rs. 2 lakh on accidental death or permanent total disability. Rs. 1 lakh on permanent partial disability. Premium only Rs. 20/year.
how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or net banking portal
tags: accident insurance cheap affordable Rs 20 disability death cover bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

eligibility.notes: Must have savings bank account with auto-debit consent.

benefits: Rs. 2 lakh life insurance cover for any cause of death. Premium only Rs. 436/year.
how_to_apply: Visit bank branch or use net banking
Coverage from June 1 to May 31 each year
tags: life insurance death cover affordable Rs 436 annual bank low cost

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)

eligibility.notes: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work. Must apply for Job Card from Gram Panchayat.

benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year per household. Current wage Rs. 200-350/day depending on state. Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days.
how_to_apply: Submit application for Job Card with family details
Apply for work at Gram Panchayat when needed
Work must be provided within 15 days of demand
Wages paid within 15 days of work completion to bank account
tags: employment rural wages 100 days labour unskilled work NREGA job card gram panchayat

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

eligibility.notes: Indian nationals. Priority to school/college dropouts and unemployed youth.

benefits: Free skill training in 300+ job roles (IT, construction, beauty, healthcare, retail etc.). Rs. 500-1500 reward on certification. Placement assistance. Training completely free.
how_to_apply: Register online or walk into nearest Skill India center
Receive skill certificate recognized by industry
tags: skill training free certificate employment job IT beauty construction healthcare PMKVY youth

name: Stand-Up India Scheme

eligibility.notes: SC/ST borrowers and women entrepreneurs. For greenfield enterprises (first-time). At least one SC/ST or woman borrower per bank branch.

benefits: Bank loan between Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore for setting up greenfield enterprise. Covers 75% of project cost. Composite loan (term loan + working capital).
how_to_apply: Loan sanctioned for eligible greenfield projects
tags: SC ST women entrepreneur business loan startup greenfield new enterprise 1 crore

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

eligibility.notes: Indian citizens aged 18-40. Must have savings bank account. Not covered under statutory social security scheme.

benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs. 1000-5000/month after age 60. Contribution Rs. 42-1454/month depending on age and pension amount chosen. Government co-contributes 50% for first 5 years (for eligible).
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch with savings account
Set up auto-debit from savings account
Can also apply via net banking or mobile banking app
tags: pension retirement savings unorganized sector guaranteed monthly pension age 60
